SELECT 'funcao campaign_results' AS item, count(*)::text AS achou FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'campaign_results'
UNION ALL SELECT 'funcao record_campaign_optout', count(*)::text FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'record_campaign_optout'
UNION ALL SELECT 'tabela campaign_optouts', count(*)::text FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'campaign_optouts'
UNION ALL SELECT 'linhas em campaign_optouts', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.campaign_optouts)::text
UNION ALL SELECT 'gatilho trg_campaign_optout', count(*)::text FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_campaign_optout' AND NOT tgisinternal
UNION ALL SELECT 'regras: ' || tablename || ' ' || cmd, count(*)::text FROM pg_policies
  WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename IN ('campaign_recipients', 'campaign_images', 'campaign_optouts') AND cmd = 'DELETE'
  GROUP BY tablename, cmd
UNION ALL SELECT 'anon pode chamar campaign_results', has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.campaign_results(uuid)', 'EXECUTE')::text
UNION ALL SELECT 'authenticated pode chamar', has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.campaign_results(uuid)', 'EXECUTE')::text
